_notice: NEVER USED. Example only: copy to v02-result\delete-config.json (gitignored, at the repository root) after the R04 installer is installed. Values in <angle brackets> are placeholders. productName must equal the DisplayName of the installer's Windows uninstall entry; installedExe must lie under its InstallLocation. collector.kind is the real collector the scenario drives (site-mail, site-messenger or site-wiki). extraScanDirs: absolute folders outside the data folder that hold engine or vector index files (empty when none).
